navigation.sql:
SELECT
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT json_agg(to_jsonb(recent))
                    FROM (
                        SELECT r.request_id, r.request_type, r.request_status,
                               r.decision_date, r.status_reason,
                               r.notification_seen_at, c.capstone_title
                        FROM request r
                        LEFT JOIN capstone c ON c.capstone_id = r.capstone_id
                        WHERE r.user_id = %s
                          AND r.request_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'promotion'
                          AND r.decision_date IS NOT NULL
                          AND r.request_status IN ('approved', 'rejected')
                        ORDER BY r.decision_date DESC, r.request_id DESC
                        LIMIT %s
                    ) recent
                ), '[]'::json) AS notifications,
                (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM request
                 WHERE user_id = %s
                   AND request_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'promotion'
                   AND decision_date IS NOT NULL
                   AND request_status IN ('approved', 'rejected')
                   AND notification_seen_at IS NULL) AS unread_count,
                COUNT(*) FILTER (
                    WHERE %s AND request_status = 'pending'
                      AND (request_type = 'manuscript'
                           OR (request_type IS NULL AND capstone_id IS NOT NULL))
                ) AS manuscript_requests,
                COUNT(*) FILTER (
                    WHERE %s AND request_status = 'pending'
                      AND request_type LIKE 'verification_%%'
                ) AS user_requests
            FROM request

WITH counts AS (
                SELECT capstone_id, COUNT(*) AS request_count, MAX(requested_at) AS last_requested_at
                FROM capstone_requests
                
                GROUP BY capstone_id
            )
            SELECT c.capstone_id, c.capstone_title, c.capstone_year, c.semester, c.term,
                   counts.request_count, counts.last_requested_at,
                   COALESCE(team.authors, '') AS authors
            FROM counts JOIN capstone c ON c.capstone_id = counts.capstone_id
            LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
                SELECT STRING_AGG(CONCAT_WS(' ', NULLIF(a.aut_first_name, ''),
                    NULLIF(a.aut_middle_name, ''), NULLIF(a.aut_last_name, '')), ', '
                    ORDER BY ca.author_order NULLS LAST, a.author_id) AS authors
                FROM capauth ca JOIN author a ON a.author_id = ca.author_id
                WHERE ca.capstone_id = c.capstone_id AND ca.role = 'Author'
            ) team ON TRUE
            WHERE c.is_archived = FALSE
            ORDER BY counts.request_count DESC, counts.last_requested_at DESC, c.capstone_id ASC
            LIMIT %s
